overview_description.description:
Sofía is a health and technology company that offers health and medical insurance services. It provides a platform with health plans for major, minor and preventive medical expenses. Included in the plan are video consultations and one ambulance service per year. The company is offering a warm interaction as every touch point with the brand becomes a customized experience.

Sofia was founded in 2018 and is based in Mexico.

about_short_description.short_description: Sofía is a health and technology company that offers health and medical insurance services.

product.name: SofíaBusiness
product.description: A comprehensive health insurance plan for companies and startups covering major, minor, and preventive medical care with zero deductible, managed via a digital platform and app.

product.name: SofíaMed
product.description: A nationwide medical network of specialists, hospitals, pharmacies, and laboratories integrated to provide healthcare services to Sofía insurance members.

product.name: Complementary Health Services
product.description: Add-on services including mental health therapy, maternal care, dental discounts, extended hospital coverage, and international medical services.

product.name: Digital Insurance Management Platform
product.description: A fully digital platform for companies to manage health insurance plans, including employee enrollment, payments, usage monitoring, and claims processing.

product.name: Telemedicine Services
product.description: Unlimited videoconferences and chat consultations with doctors accessible through the Sofía app for insured members.
